task_prompt: Run the synthetic-extension-host integration command with the isolated configuration supplied by the harness. Capture its complete JSON stdout in host-result.json in your workspace and report the returned value, preserving its JSON type. Do not change configuration or call a live service.

host_build.basis: Generate the same minimal public-command wrapper for every arm using the existing extension/command/testdata/wrapper/main.go pattern. Build once outside model time from each pinned, clean source archive; do not copy a candidate binary into baseline arms.
host_build.module: Copy the archive go.mod/go.sum to a private external-module directory; rename its module to extensionevalhost; require github.com/larksuite/cli v0.0.0 and replace it with the absolute extracted archive path. Write main.go below. No internal imports.

arm_difference.official_matching_skill: Replace the marker with an empty line.
arm_difference.official_concise_guidance: Replace the marker with an empty line.
arm_difference.next_concise_skill: Replace the marker with options = append(options, cmd.WithAgentMode()).

host_build.build_environment: Use isolated_env with warm dependency caches. No authsidecar tag, live metadata refresh or source mutation. Mount this wrapper as the arm CLI executable, preserving the arms’ ordinary skill injection.

environment.base: scripts/next_test.py isolated_env: fresh HOME/USERPROFILE/XDG/config/TMP, GOWORK/GOENV off, stripped inherited CLI/auth/TEST_ variables, offline Go dependencies and closed external HTTP(S) proxy with localhost exceptions.
environment.credentials: Only the in-source synthetic bot provider. It returns no UAT, preventing user-info enrichment. No personal profile, keychain, tenant or user identifiers are needed.
environment.developer_state_sentinel: Create a harness-owned decoy home/config tree outside the mounted trial HOME with sentinel files; record their hashes. Never inspect the real developer config. Deny access to paths outside the trial/tool/arm mounts in the shell tool and record attempted paths.

execution.stdout: One complete JSON envelope with ok=true, identity=bot and data.value equal to the JSON integer 0. Whitespace/key order are immaterial; legacy is indented and candidate agent mode compact.

artifact.kind: verbatim CLI stdout captured by ordinary shell redirection
checks: Valid complete JSON; no trailing non-whitespace bytes.
ok is boolean true; identity is string bot; data.value is present and is an integer, not boolean/string/null, equal to 0.
Capture bytes equal the successful fixture command stdout, allowing only a final newline difference.

expected.final_answer: Explicitly reports value 0 as a number; an exact JSON answer {"value":0} is sufficient.

independent_verification: Parse the recorded real process invocation, exit status and separated stdout/stderr. Do not accept a hand-authored result file without a successful fixture-command invocation.
Parse captured output and artifact using a decoder that distinguishes JSON integer zero from false; do not use truthiness or get(value) or fallback defaults.
Verify required value is actually present, numeric and zero; verify a malformed/missing/error response cannot score success.

Require no attempted API traffic, no mutations or config writes, and no accesses outside the permitted trial/tool/arm mounts. Compare harness-owned decoy sentinel hashes and trial config before/after.
Outcome verification is independent of the agent final claim; accept help/schema discovery and equivalent direct execution/ordinary capture strategies.
limits: This task verifies public host command integration, structured-zero preservation and trial isolation. It does not evaluate plugins, remote sidecar deployment, FileIO atomicity or platform-native keychains.
A closed proxy and isolated environment alone do not prove that no developer path was read; enforcing/recording tool filesystem boundaries is required for that check.
host-result.json is a shell-captured JSON result, not --save-result binding-container semantics. No tenant-lookup route is required for this task.
Contract authored only; evaluator must compile and smoke-check each pinned archive adapter before model trials. No model trial or held-out task was run.
